note: Known cross-platform divergences on fixtures/visual-test.json, seeded from a live three-platform run (327 pairs, 23 failing at SSIM<0.95 || dpx>2%). A LEDGER, not a tolerance: each line names one divergence, why it is believed benign or why it is a bug, who owns it, and when it must be re-reviewed. Deleting a line is how a fix gets recorded. READ THIS: 6 of these entries are REAL SIZE BUGS surfaced for the first time by the magenta pad sentinel - before that fix a short render was padded with the capture background and scored a perfect diff. They carry a short expiry because they need fixing, not excusing. Of the remainder, almost all fail on SSIM alone with dpx well under the 2% budget and deltaE95 = 0.00 - the colours are exact and SSIM is scoring curve/transform anti-aliasing. That is evidence about the METRIC, not the runtimes, and most of those lines should evaporate when the gate moves off SSIM.
